title: Complete PEN dispatch to prod-worthy final receipts
objective: Use the bridge/runtime worker path to complete all accepted PEN jobs that are safe to execute, validate outputs, write final REAL/PARTIAL/BLOCKED/FAILED receipts, and update Pen/dev/prod state counts.

tasks.name: scan_pen_jobs
tasks.action: Read inbox/*.json and receipts/runtime/*.receipt.json, identify ACCEPTED jobs without receipts/final/*.final.receipt.json.

tasks.name: classify_and_gate
tasks.action: Classify each job as safe_to_execute, blocked_hard_gate, invalid_payload, duplicate, or already_finalised.

tasks.name: execute_safe_jobs
tasks.action: For safe jobs, execute through bridge/runtime worker with idempotency key and requested_state=PROD_WORTHY_MINIMUM.

tasks.name: validate
tasks.action: Run relevant build/test/smoke/validation checks before marking PROD_MINIMUM or REAL.

tasks.name: write_final_receipts
tasks.action: Write receipts/final/<idempotency_key>.final.receipt.json with state REAL, PARTIAL, BLOCKED, or FAILED; include error, impact, rollback, next, runtime evidence, and validation evidence.

tasks.name: update_counts
tasks.action: Write state/pen_state_counts.json and state/pen_state_counts.md with Pen, Dev, Validating, Prod, Real, Partial, Blocked, Failed, Archived counts.

tasks.name: close_loop
tasks.action: Commit all final receipts and state counts to TML-4PM/the-pen and return the commit SHA as receipt evidence.

success_criteria: No accepted safe job remains without a final receipt
Blocked jobs name the exact hard gate
Failed jobs include error, impact, rollback, next
State counts exist and are committed
No destructive/payment/IAM/credential/legal action is executed without gate
